answers.evidence:
Verified with 6 passing tests:

| Test | Scenario | Result |
|------|----------|--------|
| `TestEnabledField_Present` | Compile-time check that `Enabled` bool field exists and is settable | PASS |
| `TestSpawnTick_SkipsDisabledProject` | Mixed enabled+disabled; only enabled gets ticks | PASS |
| `TestSpawnTick_AllProjectsEnabled` | All enabled; all receive ticks | PASS |
| `TestSpawnTick_AllProjectsDisabled` | All disabled; none receive ticks | PASS |
| `TestSpawnTick_DisabledProjectDoesNotGetFutureTicks` | Disabled project with very short interval run 10 cycles → still 0 ticks | PASS |
| `TestSpawnTick_ProjectEnabledAfterCreation` | Disabled at creation → 0 ticks; flip to enabled → tick fires | PASS |

**Edge cases covered:**
- **Zero-value struct**: `Project{Enabled: false}` (default) correctly disables
- **Toggling at runtime**: A project disabled at creation can be enabled later and will start receiving ticks
- **All-disabled fleet**: No ticks dispatched, no goroutine leaks
- **Mixed fleet**: Only enabled projects consume scheduler resources
- **Race safety**: The guard is checked inside the evaluation loop before the goroutine is spawned
